en: A multi-view color postcard with a yellow border showing various street scenes, squares, monuments, and buildings of the city of Pécs, including historic facades, a statue of a rider on horseback, and a cathedral-like structure. The word "Pécs" is prominently printed in red letters on the front. The reverse side features a faint background image of a large Romanesque cathedral with four towers (the Pécs Cathedral), standard postcard address lines, stamp boxes, barcodes, and greetings in multiple languages.
